{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Remove duplicate patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we have one row per patient
data_clean = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", data_clean.shape[0])

# Check the distribution of severity in the cleaned data
print("Severity distribution after deduplication:\n", data_clean['severity'].value_counts())

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = data_clean['severity'].value_counts()['severe']
total_patients = data_clean.shape[0]
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Fraction of patients with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
